concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-oauth-flow]] — 2026-09-15 third-party-provider open-banking OAuth and separate account-holder consent-ID flow for Business Accounts, with five-minute code, rotating refresh token and approval boundary; distinct from Partner OAuth and external-individual account verification.
warnings: Captured refresh-token prose says both immediate expiry on use and expiry with a short grace period; consentStatus received is not holder approval.
